items.title: NatWest private banking and wealth management income rises 47% in Q3
items.summary: NatWest reported a £143m increase in private banking and wealth management income for the three months to September, supported by the integration of Evelyn Partners.

items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorised clone firm using Octopus Investments name
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against an unauthorised clone firm operating under the name Client.octopus-firm.com.

items.title: Specialist cyber policies extend cover to personal relocation and trauma counselling
items.summary: Specialist cyber insurers are updating policy wordings to cover the personal trauma, counselling and temporary relocation costs faced by executives targeted in ransomware attacks.

items.title: UK house prices grow at slowest pace in two years as mortgage rates rise
items.summary: Nationwide reports annual UK house price growth slowed to 0.5% in October as higher borrowing costs weighed on buyers.

items.title: Financial Conduct Authority issues warning over Northern Index Clone firm
items.summary: The FCA warns consumers against dealing with an unauthorised clone firm operating under the name Northern Index.

items.title: Precautionary closures amid protests carry no insurance guarantee
items.summary: Businesses closing doors ahead of unrest face strict policy limits as standard property damage and business interruption wordings require physical damage or formal authority orders.
